relationships.label: HALEU fuel LOI
relationships.detail: LOI to supply HALEU for up to five Aurora powerhouses from 2029, possibly with Oklo prepayments. Source: Centrus / Oklo press release, Jun 18, 2026.

relationships.label: 150 MW geothermal
relationships.detail: Portfolio PPA for up to 150 MW of new Nevada geothermal (2028–2030) supporting Google data centers through NV Energy; subject to PUCN approval. Source: Ormat press release, Feb 17, 2026.

relationships.label: Gas to 3 Oracle data centers
relationships.detail: Supply of up to 900 MMcf/d of natural gas to three Oracle data centers; first lateral to the Abilene, TX campus flowing since early 2026, two more due mid-2026. Source: NGI, Feb 17, 2026.

relationships.label: Socrates behind-the-meter gas
relationships.detail: Off-grid gas power plants (Socrates North/South 400 MW; Socrates the Younger 250 MW + 116 MW batteries) for a Meta affiliate’s New Albany, Ohio campus. Source: Ohio Power Siting Board, 2025–Jun 2026.

relationships.label: 10.5 GW renewables framework
relationships.detail: Framework to deliver >10.5 GW of new renewable capacity in the US and Europe, 2026–2030. Source: Brookfield / Microsoft release, May 2024.

relationships.label: Hydro framework 3 GW
relationships.detail: Hydro framework for up to 3,000 MW; first 20-yr PPAs for 670 MW at Holtwood and Safe Harbor (PA). Source: Brookfield press release, Jul 2025.

relationships.label: Westinghouse co-owners
relationships.detail: Cameco (49%) and Brookfield Renewable with partners (51%) own Westinghouse; binding term sheet with the US Commerce Dept for ≥$80B of AP1000 reactors, incl. power for AI data centers. Source: Cameco release, Oct 28, 2025.

relationships.label: 800 VDC / Vera Rubin DSX
relationships.detail: Vertiv co-develops NVIDIA’s 800 VDC power architecture and supplies converged power/cooling building blocks for the Vera Rubin DSX AI-factory design. Source: Vertiv press release, Mar 16, 2026.

relationships.label: 800 VDC ecosystem
relationships.detail: Eaton reference designs for 800 VDC power to megawatt-scale NVIDIA racks. Source: Eaton / NVIDIA technical blog, 2025.

relationships.label: Gas-turbine rivals
relationships.detail: The two largest heavy-duty gas-turbine OEMs, both with multi-year backlogs and ~20% of recent orders from data centers. Source: Reuters Aug 5, 2026; Utility Dive Jul 23, 2026.

relationships.label: SMR rivals
relationships.detail: Competing SMR/advanced-reactor developers for utility (TVA–ENTRA1 6 GW) and hyperscaler (Meta, Switch) demand. Source: TVA release Sep 2, 2025; Oklo Jan 2026.
